newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down one cent on higher offering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down one cent on higher offering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down one cent at 14.62 ringgit ($5.89) a kg, pressured by a larger offering at the opening, traders said. There were initial offers for 93 tonnes against bids for 59 tonnes. Final turnover was 83 tonnes against 85 on Wednesday, with buying again coming from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.

Traders said a steady London Metal Exchange (LME) close overnight had no impact on the local market which is seen consolidating after recent gains. The local price premium over the LME widened slightly to $30 a tonne from $25 previously.
